name: AdGuard Home DNS Detection
name_zh: AdGuard Home DNS 偵測套組
summary: Decoder and rules for AdGuard Home query logs - the only log that records which client asked for a domain.
summary_zh: AdGuard Home 查詢記錄的解碼器與規則。這是唯一記錄「哪一台主機查詢了某網域」的來源。
notes: AdGuard Home must forward its query log by syslog with the program name adguard; each message body is a single JSON object.

This pack is the attribution layer for DNS detections. A recursive resolver or a firewall only sees the resolver's own address as the query source, so without AdGuard a malicious lookup cannot be traced back to a host.

Ordinary ad and tracker blocking stays at level 0 and never alerts. Only threat-list blocks (130901) and filter-evasion blocks (130902) surface directly; volume from one client is handled by correlation.
PREREQUISITE - AdGuard must sit in front of the clients. If clients query a resolver that then forwards to AdGuard, every event carries the resolver's address and attribution is lost.

The base rule 130900 is level 2, not level 0, on purpose: <if_matched_sid> does not fire against a level 0 rule, so the correlation rules would be dead. Level 2 is still below the default alert threshold, so it writes no alerts.
Verified on Wazuh 4.14.7 against live traffic from AdGuard Home.

A block is a control that fired, so 130902 alerts at level 3 rather than staying silent. Volume is real - four Apple and Chrome devices produced 152 of these in a single day, all for the same five encrypted-DNS endpoints - so 130912 adds a once-per-hour summary per client for the case that needs chasing: a device that keeps trying.
notes_zh: AdGuard Home 需以 syslog 轉送查詢記錄，程式名稱須為 adguard，訊息本體為單一 JSON 物件。
本套組是 DNS 偵測的溯源層。遞迴解析器或防火牆只看得到解析器自己的位址，沒有 AdGuard 就無法把惡意查詢追回到哪一台主機。
一般廣告與追蹤器封鎖停在 level 0 不告警；只有威脅清單封鎖（130901）與規避封鎖（130902）會直接浮現，單一用戶端的量則交給關聯規則處理。
前提條件 - AdGuard 必須位於用戶端前方。若用戶端查詢的是另一台解析器再轉給 AdGuard，每筆事件都只會帶解析器的位址，溯源能力就沒了。
基礎規則 130900 刻意設為 level 2 而非 0：`<if_matched_sid>` 對 level 0 的規則不會觸發，設 0 會讓關聯規則失效。level 2 仍低於預設告警門檻，不會產生告警。
已在 Wazuh 4.14.7 上以 AdGuard Home 的實際流量驗證。
擋下來就是控制生效了，所以 130902 以 level 3 告警而非靜默。量確實不小 —— 實測四台 Apple 與 Chrome 裝置一天產生 152 筆，全部指向同樣五個加密 DNS 端點 —— 因此 130912 另外以「每台每小時一次」的形式補上真正需要追的情況：持續嘗試的裝置。
author: Jason Tools

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body: Install from this page, then use Reload Ruleset on the Rules tab. A cluster synchronises rule files but does not reload the workers.
setup.body_zh: 在本頁安裝後，到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集只同步規則檔、不會重載 worker。

setup.title: Forward the AdGuard Home query log by syslog
setup.title_zh: 以 syslog 轉送 AdGuard Home 查詢記錄
setup.body: Send the query log to the Wazuh manager by syslog with the program name adguard, one JSON object per message, and allow the AdGuard host in the manager's syslog <remote> block.
setup.body_zh: 把查詢記錄以 syslog 送到 Wazuh 管理端，program name 為 adguard，每則訊息一個 JSON 物件；並在管理端 syslog 的 <remote> 允許 AdGuard 主機。

setup.title: Put AdGuard in front of the clients
setup.title_zh: 讓 AdGuard 直接面對用戶端
setup.body: Clients must query AdGuard directly. If they query another resolver that forwards to AdGuard, every event carries that resolver's address and a lookup can no longer be traced to a host.
setup.body_zh: 用戶端必須直接查詢 AdGuard。若用戶端先查另一台解析器再轉給 AdGuard，每筆事件都只會是那台解析器的位址，無法追到發出查詢的主機。
